notes.title: Mac Compatibility
notes.notes: [p]I have scaled the inhospitable cliffs that are MacOS development and brought a Mac playable demo for Destroy the Wall for you all. The demo was designed on Mac 26 Tahoe and should be playable slightly older versions, though I'm not sure exactly how far back backwards compatibility goes. The full game will also be available on Mac when it releases. [/p]

notes.title: Linux Compatibility
notes.notes: [p]The Destroy the Wall main game and demo have been built for Ubuntu 24.04. The demo is playable on  all distros which can run Steam Linux games now and the full game will be playable on these distros when it releases. Now Steam users on Linux can enjoy Destroy the Wall as well! [/p]

notes.title: Revamped Demo
notes.notes: [p]The demo has now been updated to match the progress I've made on Destroy the Wall over the last two years. It now features the updated difficulty system, a more comprehensive tutorial, and numerous bug fixes and game feel updates. Most exciting of all, the second area in the game has been added to the demo to give players a bigger sample of what they can expect from the full game.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions or comments, shoot me an email at jack@kingsnakegames.com or join [url="https://discord.com/invite/6byZWdwRcW"]our discord[/url][/p]
